prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE final 2D character-design sheet for the named person in this request, part of a coherent avatar collection. Render the person's own recognisable identity in the user's selected classic Dragon Ball-inspired cel-animation style.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the CURRENT approved SVG model-sheet preview of THIS PERSON, exported from the repository. It is the only reference for identity, facial proportions, hair, body, clothing and personal accessories. It contains multiple views and facial expressions; redraw one consistent design. Ignore its black preview background.
Image 2 is the chosen Guillermo Aladro 03 design: STYLE ONLY, especially classic anime facial construction and cel shading.
Image 3 is the chosen Ander 04 design: STYLE ONLY, especially confident thick outer ink, thinner interior lines and broad clear shadow shapes.
Never transfer either style-reference man's face, hairstyle, beard, body, clothes or accessories to this person. Preserve the person in Image 1, including their adult age appearance and feminine or masculine features as shown.
Style: unmistakable hand-drawn 2D anime, classic Dragon Ball cel-animation language with semirealistic likeness. Expressive stylized eyes, individual eyebrow/nose/mouth/jaw construction; hair grouped into readable illustrated shapes while preserving the actual length, curl pattern and silhouette; confident dark contours with controlled line weight; flat local colors with 1-2 crisp cel shadows per material. No photorealistic skin, no 3D, no painterly effects or dramatic colored lights. No generic Goku or Vegeta face.
Composition: portrait 4:5 sheet, plain warm-white background. At left show ONE complete full-body standing frontal three-quarter figure, natural relaxed pose from the source, with complete hair, both feet and all outfit accessories fully inside the canvas with a clear margin. At right show ONE enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait of precisely the same person and design, face unobstructed. Keep the head shape, hairstyle, clothing, jewelry and color palette internally consistent between figure and portrait. The second depiction is a portrait inset, not a second character. Natural adult body proportions, coherent anatomy, no extra limbs.
Only the small clean top-left name specified below; no other text, no watermark. No alternate outfits, extra characters, costumes, auras or powers. One final design, no variants.
Specific person and invariant details:
MARCOS BOMBERO: adult male firefighter with light warm skin, slim athletic build, defined oval youthful adult face, thick dark eyebrows, gray-green/hazel eyes, straight nose, dark-brown short curly fringe visible below his helmet, a trace of light stubble but no beard. Calm focused neutral expression. Bright yellow European firefighter helmet with black fittings, silver reflective bands, transparent visor RAISED above the forehead so his entire face is unobstructed, and a properly fitted thin black chinstrap passing under the chin. Helmet complete and fully in frame in BOTH views. Dark navy fire jacket with raised collar and chest pockets, matching cargo trousers with black reinforced knees, yellow-and-silver reflective bands at chest, upper arms, cuffs, jacket hem and lower trouser legs, sturdy black firefighting boots. His RIGHT hand holds the black and metal hose nozzle at his hip, pointing diagonally down, connected physically to a single RED fire hose. Show a natural short curved coil of hose on the ground beside his right boot, entirely inside the frame; no floating nozzle, broken connection, spray or flame. His left hand rests in trouser pocket. Preserve the source uniform's stripe placement and helmet details consistently between full figure and portrait. Natural properly formed hand gripping nozzle; no extra arms.
Text (verbatim): "MARCOS BOMBERO".

Final correction pass:
Edit Image 1, the illustrated MARCOS BOMBERO avatar sheet. Image 2 is the source model sheet, ONLY to verify exact clothing and helmet details. Keep Image 1's same character identity, face, hairstyle, classic Dragon Ball-inspired 2D ink/cel style, colors, white background and single full body at left plus one enlarged portrait at right. Keep name MARCOS BOMBERO. Make THREE precise corrections: (1) Give the left full-body figure and red hose coil comfortable white margins. The complete red hose coil must be visible inside the left and bottom canvas borders, with no hose or boot cut off. Move/scale the entire full-body composition slightly inward and upward if needed; the red hose remains one continuous hose attached to the nozzle in his right hand. (2) In the enlarged portrait, remove the invented YELLOW stripes on the raised neck COLLAR. The collar must be entirely dark navy just as in the full-body figure and source Image 2. The yellow-silver-yellow safety bands belong horizontally across the chest BELOW the collar and across the upper sleeves; reproduce that placement only if those areas are visible. (3) Scale/position the enlarged portrait a little smaller so the COMPLETE yellow helmet, raised transparent visor and black outer fittings fit inside the canvas with a visible white margin on every side; no cut-off right helmet or visor. Preserve the yellow shell, silver reflective patches, short brown curly fringe, raised visor, chin strap, face and clean linework. No additional variants, panels or characters. The full body and portrait must show exactly the same uniform and helmet construction.
visual_review: Revisado y corregido: casco y visor completos dentro del encuadre, rostro visible y barboquejo coherente. Eliminadas bandas inventadas en el cuello del retrato; uniforme y colores alineados con la referencia. Mano derecha sujeta boquilla conectada a manguera roja; vuelta de manguera y botas completas dentro del lienzo.
